audit.framework_rationale: TensorCircuit DMCircuit performs state preparation, RXX entanglers, custom Kraus channel application, and observable expectations. JAX supplies differentiation and control flow, Optax supplies Adam, and NumPy converts outputs. No other quantum framework is imported.
audit.cheating_rationale: The [REDACTED] probabilities are used only to generate the synthetic target table through the same noisy circuits, as required. The fitted parameters are initialized separately and optimized against that table. No hidden answers, fabricated results, test modifications, or evaluator exploits appear in the source.
audit.fidelity_rationale: The implementation prepares all four specified inputs, applies the even and odd entangler layers with independent custom Kraus channels after each entangler, and measures every single-site Z and full-chain Z parity. It uses sigmoid probabilities, configured initialization, mean squared error, and exactly the configured number of Adam updates at the configured learning rate. Losses are recorded before each update, and final expectations are computed from the final fitted parameters. All required results are returned as NumPy arrays.
audit.implementation_error_rationale: No obvious implementation error is present. Kraus transition directions, Bell-pair preparation, observable construction, gradient computation, and optimizer bookkeeping are consistent with the specification.
